card.product_version_note: Refreshed June 23, 2025 (annual fee raised to $795; authorized users $195 each). Per the Chase press release of June 23, 2025: 'Cardmembers who applied prior to June 23, 2025, will experience these new benefits and features starting October 26, 2025.' and 'Their annual fee will be adjusted to $795 on their next anniversary date following October 26, 2025.' Points earned before October 26, 2025 'can be redeemed at 1.5x on Chase Travel until October 26, 2027'; Chase states cardmembers automatically receive the better of Points Boost or 1.5x on Chase Travel. The $75,000 spend tier counts purchases starting with calendar year 2025. The Edit $500 hotel credit starts 1/1/2026. The press release described a limited-time acquisition offer (100,000 points plus a $500 Chase Travel credit after $5,000 in 3 months) that differs from the offer on the product page today (100,000 points after $6,000 in 3 months); the product page offer is recorded here.

benefits.name: $300 Annual Travel Credit
benefits.period_note: Up to $300 in statement credits per account anniversary year. The anniversary year runs from the account open date through the first statement date after the anniversary of the account open date, plus 12 monthly billing cycles.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Purchases in the travel category. Any portion of a purchase that qualifies for the credit does not earn points. Excludes some merchants whose primary business is not travel, such as gift card merchants, points and miles sellers, in-flight purchases, and merchants located inside hotels or airports. Credits may be reversed for returns or if the account is closed within 90 days of receiving a credit.

benefits.name: $500 Credit for stays with The Edit (Chase Travel)
benefits.period_note: Up to $250 per qualifying prepaid 'Pay Now' booking, for a total maximum of $500 in statement credits per calendar year. Starts 1/1/2026.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Prepaid 'Pay Now' bookings at The Edit properties made through Chase Travel by the primary cardmember or an authorized user; two-night minimum stay. Any portion of the purchase that qualifies for the credit does not earn points.

benefits.name: The Edit on-property benefits
benefits.units: $100 property credit, daily breakfast for two, complimentary Wi-Fi, room upgrade, early check-in and late check-out (subject to availability)
benefits.period_note: Per eligible stay booked through Chase Travel at The Edit properties. Chase cites '$550+ value' per stay.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Benefits vary by property and availability, apply per room (double occupancy), cannot be redeemed for cash, and cannot be combined with other offers.

benefits.name: $300 Dining Credit (Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables)
benefits.period_note: Up to $150 January through June and up to $150 July through December, for a total of up to $300 per calendar year. Unused amounts from one half do not carry into the next.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Dining purchases at select restaurants in the Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables program on OpenTable (opentable.com/sapphire-reserve-exclusive-tables). Purchases must be identifiable as made directly with the restaurant. Merchandise, gift cards, and purchases made through third-party services (for example delivery platforms) do not qualify.

benefits.name: $300 StubHub and viagogo Credit
benefits.period_note: Up to $150 January through June and up to $150 July through December, for a total of up to $300 per calendar year, through 12/31/2027. No minimum purchase.
benefits.enrollment_note: One-time activation required on chase.com or in the Chase Mobile app.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Qualifying purchases with StubHub and viagogo. Gift cards excluded. Purchases for events in the UK are completed through StubHub International and do not qualify.

benefits.name: Complimentary Apple TV and Apple Music subscriptions
benefits.units: At least 12 months of complimentary Apple TV and Apple Music from the activation date; Chase cites '$324/yr value'
benefits.period_note: At least 12 months from activation. Activation must be completed by June 22, 2027. Cardmembers with a paid Apple One subscription receive an $8.00 monthly discount on Apple One instead.
benefits.enrollment_note: One-time activation on chase.com or the Chase Mobile app required by June 22, 2027. Primary cardmember only.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Subscription benefit, not a statement credit. Primary cardmember only.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28. End date is the activation deadline; subscription continues at least 12 months from activation.

benefits.name: Complimentary DoorDash DashPass membership
benefits.units: DashPass membership for 12 months or until 12/31/2029, whichever is longer; Chase cites '$120 value'
benefits.period_note: Membership runs until December 31, 2029 or for 12 months from activation, whichever is longer.
benefits.enrollment_note: Activate by December 31, 2029. Must use the enrolled Sapphire Reserve card as the payment method at DoorDash checkout. U.S. address required.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: DoorDash (U.S.).

benefits.name: DoorDash monthly promotions (up to $35 per month)
benefits.units: One $15 off promo on any qualifying DoorDash order plus two $10 off promos, each on a separate qualifying non-restaurant order
benefits.period_note: Up to $35 per calendar month (Chase cites up to $420 per year), available through 12/31/2029. Unused promos expire at month end and do not roll over.
benefits.enrollment_note: Requires an active DashPass membership enrolled with the Sapphire Reserve card; promos apply at DoorDash checkout.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Promotions apply to the order subtotal only. The $15 promo applies to one qualifying order of any type; the two $10 promos apply to separate qualifying non-restaurant orders. Applied as DoorDash checkout promotions rather than card statement credits.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28. Typed as statement_credit for tracking purposes although Chase delivers it as a checkout promotion.

benefits.name: $10 monthly Lyft credit
benefits.period_note: $10 Lyft credit each calendar month, up to $120 in a 12-month period, through 9/30/2027. Unused credit expires at month end.
benefits.enrollment_note: Add the Sapphire Reserve card as the payment method in the Lyft app; the credit goes to the cardmember who first adds the card. No separate chase.com activation step is described.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Lyft rideshare modes only. Excludes fees, tips, and gift cards.

benefits.name: Peloton membership statement credit
benefits.period_note: Up to $10 per month, capped at $120 per calendar year, through 12/31/2027.
benefits.enrollment_note: One-time activation required on chase.com or the Chase Mobile app, plus sign-up or sign-in through onepeloton.com/digital/promotions/chase.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Peloton All-Access Membership, Rental, App+, Guide, App One, or Strength+ memberships purchased directly from Peloton in the U.S. Purchases made outside the U.S. and through third-party app stores do not qualify.

benefits.name: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite status
benefits.units: IHG One Rewards Platinum Elite
benefits.period_note: Valid through 12/31/2027 while the card remains open.
benefits.enrollment_note: Link an IHG One Rewards account on chase.com or in the Chase Mobile app. Activation can take up to 3 weeks.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Primary cardmember only; the card must remain open.

benefits.name: Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee credit
benefits.period_note: One statement credit of up to $120 every four years.
benefits.enrollment_note: Applied automatically when the application fee is charged to the card.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Application fees charged directly by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security, its approved partners, or TSA-authorized enrollment providers. Third-party services that handle applications do not qualify.

benefits.name: Priority Pass Select lounge membership
benefits.units: Complimentary Priority Pass Select membership; cardmember plus up to two guests; $27 per additional guest per visit
benefits.period_note: Ongoing while the card is open.
benefits.enrollment_note: Chase states Priority Pass Select is automatically activated for primary cardmembers and authorized users.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Physical Priority Pass card or the Priority Pass digital card is required for entry; digital wallet cards are not accepted. Additional guests beyond two are charged $27 per guest per visit.

benefits.name: Chase Sapphire Lounge by The Club access
benefits.units: Cardmember plus up to two guests
benefits.period_note: Ongoing while the card is open.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Chase Sapphire Lounges by The Club; see account.chase.com/sapphire-airport-lounge for locations.

benefits.name: Air Canada Maple Leaf Lounge and Cafe access
benefits.units: Cardmember plus one guest; additional guests $59 (USD at U.S. lounges)
benefits.period_note: Ongoing while the card is open.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Access when departing on a Star Alliance flight. Signature Suites and Montreal (YUL) lounges are excluded.

benefits.name: Reserve Travel Designers
benefits.units: Complimentary travel planning service; Chase cites up to $300 in value per trip; no agency fees (supplier fees may apply)
benefits.period_note: Per trip.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Primary cardmember only. Bookings earn 8x only if booked directly through Chase Travel; FROSCH and Valerie Wilson Travel purchases do not qualify for the Chase Travel rate.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.period_note: Ongoing.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Applies to all purchases.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28 (product page; Pricing & Terms page itself was not fetchable).

benefits.name: Welcome offer: 100,000 bonus points
benefits.units: 100,000 Ultimate Rewards points
benefits.period_note: After $6,000 in purchases in the first 3 months from account opening. Points post within 6 to 8 weeks after qualifying.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Not available to applicants who currently hold the card, previously held it, or previously received a new cardmember bonus for this product.

benefits.name: World of Hyatt Explorist status ($75,000 spend tier)
benefits.units: World of Hyatt Explorist
benefits.period_note: Status lasts through the remainder of the qualifying calendar year, the following calendar year, and through February of the calendar year after that.
benefits.enrollment_note: Link a World of Hyatt account on chase.com or in the Chase Mobile app. Allow up to 3 weeks for activation. Allow 1 to 2 weeks after reaching $75,000 for tier benefits to appear.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Requires $75,000 in purchases on the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card in a calendar year. Chase may remove tier benefits for misuse.

unlock.counting_rule: Purchases made with the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card between January 1 and December 31 of each year, starting with 2025, count toward the $75,000 requirement. Balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions, and fees of any kind (including the annual fee) do not count. Returns are not addressed in the footnote. Benefits apply for the remainder of the calendar year in which the cardmember qualifies and continue through the following calendar year unless stated otherwise. Spend made before a product downgrade does not count toward a later upgrade.

benefits.name: IHG One Rewards Diamond Elite status ($75,000 spend tier)
benefits.units: IHG One Rewards Diamond Elite
benefits.period_note: Status lasts through the remainder of the qualifying calendar year and the following calendar year.
benefits.enrollment_note: Link an IHG One Rewards account; if Platinum Elite status is already active through the card, Diamond Elite activates automatically. Allow 1 to 2 weeks after reaching $75,000 for tier benefits to appear.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Requires $75,000 in purchases on the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card in a calendar year. Chase may remove tier benefits for misuse.

unlock.counting_rule: Purchases made with the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card between January 1 and December 31 of each year, starting with 2025, count toward the $75,000 requirement. Balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions, and fees of any kind (including the annual fee) do not count. Returns are not addressed in the footnote. Benefits apply for the remainder of the calendar year in which the cardmember qualifies and continue through the following calendar year unless stated otherwise. Spend made before a product downgrade does not count toward a later upgrade.

benefits.name: $250 The Shops at Chase credit ($75,000 spend tier)
benefits.period_note: Up to $250 in statement credits per qualifying period (remainder of the qualifying year plus the following calendar year). If the cardmember qualifies in consecutive years, the most available at one time is $500.
benefits.enrollment_note: Applied automatically. Allow 1 to 2 weeks after reaching $75,000 for tier benefits to appear.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Purchases at The Shops at Chase. Requires $75,000 in purchases on the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card in a calendar year.

unlock.counting_rule: Purchases made with the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card between January 1 and December 31 of each year, starting with 2025, count toward the $75,000 requirement. Balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions, and fees of any kind (including the annual fee) do not count. Returns are not addressed in the footnote. Benefits apply for the remainder of the calendar year in which the cardmember qualifies and continue through the following calendar year unless stated otherwise. Spend made before a product downgrade does not count toward a later upgrade.

benefits.name: $500 Southwest Airlines credit via Chase Travel ($75,000 spend tier)
benefits.period_note: Up to $500 in statement credits per qualifying period, expiring at the end of the calendar year following the qualifying year. If the cardmember qualifies in consecutive years, the most available at one time is $1,000.
benefits.enrollment_note: Applied automatically. Allow 1 to 2 weeks after reaching $75,000 for tier benefits to appear.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Southwest Airlines purchases booked through Chase Travel. Any portion of a purchase covered by the credit does not earn points. Requires $75,000 in purchases on the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card in a calendar year.

unlock.counting_rule: Purchases made with the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card between January 1 and December 31 of each year, starting with 2025, count toward the $75,000 requirement. Balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions, and fees of any kind (including the annual fee) do not count. Returns are not addressed in the footnote. Benefits apply for the remainder of the calendar year in which the cardmember qualifies and continue through the following calendar year unless stated otherwise. Spend made before a product downgrade does not count toward a later upgrade.

benefits.name: Southwest Airlines A-List status ($75,000 spend tier)
benefits.units: Southwest Rapid Rewards A-List
benefits.period_note: Status lasts through December 31 of the calendar year following the qualifying year.
benefits.enrollment_note: Link a Southwest Rapid Rewards membership number. Allow 10 to 15 business days for activation. Allow 1 to 2 weeks after reaching $75,000 for tier benefits to appear.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Requires $75,000 in purchases on the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card in a calendar year. Chase may remove tier benefits for misuse.

unlock.counting_rule: Purchases made with the Sapphire Reserve or J.P. Morgan Reserve card between January 1 and December 31 of each year, starting with 2025, count toward the $75,000 requirement. Balance transfers, cash advances, cash-like transactions, and fees of any kind (including the annual fee) do not count. Returns are not addressed in the footnote. Benefits apply for the remainder of the calendar year in which the cardmember qualifies and continue through the following calendar year unless stated otherwise. Spend made before a product downgrade does not count toward a later upgrade.

benefits.name: Auto Rental Collision Damage Waiver (primary)
benefits.period_note: Per rental; rentals up to 31 consecutive days.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Primary coverage for theft and collision damage up to $75,000 on most rental vehicles in the U.S. and abroad when the entire rental is paid with the card and/or rewards and the rental agency's CDW/LDW is declined. In New York, domestic coverage is secondary. Many vehicle types excluded (cargo vans, motorcycles, vehicles over 20 years old, and others). Report incidents within 100 days.
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance
benefits.units: Up to $10,000 per traveler, $20,000 per trip, and $40,000 per 12-month period per account
benefits.period_note: Per trip, with a $40,000 cap per 12 months per account.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Trip must be paid with the card and/or rewards and last no more than 60 days. Pre-existing conditions treated within 60 days before booking are excluded. Supplier credit vouchers are not reimbursed until they expire. Interruption coverage adds rental return costs and up to $250 ground transport for necessary medical treatment.
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: Trip Delay Reimbursement
benefits.units: Up to $500 per traveler
benefits.period_note: Per covered delay.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Common carrier delays of more than 6 hours or requiring an overnight stay; covers unreimbursed expenses such as meals and lodging.
benefits.verification_note: Read on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28; the Guide to Benefits section for this benefit was truncated in the fetch.

benefits.name: Travel Accident Insurance
benefits.units: Up to $1,000,000 common carrier coverage per traveler; $100,000 24-hour coverage
benefits.period_note: Per covered trip.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Accidental death and dismemberment when common carrier transportation is paid with the card and/or rewards. Loss must occur within one year of the accident. Aggregate limit per accident is two times the maximum benefit.
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: Lost Luggage Reimbursement
benefits.units: Up to $3,000 per traveler per trip (New York: $2,000 per bag, $10,000 per trip); $500 sub-limits for jewelry/watches and cameras/electronics
benefits.period_note: Per trip.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Checked or carry-on luggage lost or damaged by a common carrier. Pays the difference between actual cash value and the carrier's reimbursement. Coverage is secondary. Start the claim within 20 days.
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: Baggage Delay Insurance
benefits.units: Up to $100 per day for up to 5 days
benefits.period_note: Per covered delay.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Checked baggage delayed or misdirected by a common carrier for more than 6 hours. Report the delay to the carrier and start the claim within 20 days. Coverage is secondary.
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: Emergency Evacuation and Transportation
benefits.units: Up to $100,000 for medically necessary evacuation; up to $15,000 for repatriation of remains
benefits.period_note: Per covered trip.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Trip must be 5 to 60 days long, more than 100 miles from home, prepaid, and paid with the card and/or rewards. Services must be authorized in advance by the service provider (AXA Assistance USA) and certified by a physician. Not an insurance benefit.
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: Emergency Medical and Dental Benefit
benefits.units: Up to $2,500 with a $50 deductible per traveler per trip; plus $75 per day up to 5 days for hotel recovery after hospital discharge
benefits.period_note: Per covered trip.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Emergency treatment on trips more than 100 miles from home. Secondary to other insurance. Routine dental excluded. Start the claim within 90 days of care; submit documents within 180 days.
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: Roadside Assistance
benefits.units: Up to $50 per service event, up to 4 events per year
benefits.period_note: Up to 4 service events per year; one event per service type per 7-day period.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Towing, tire change, battery jump, lockout (no key replacement), fuel delivery (cost of up to 2 gallons), and winching. Vehicles must be 10,000 lbs or less. Not insurance; the cardmember pays charges above $50.
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services
benefits.period_note: Available while traveling.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Referral and coordination service only (legal, medical, and other referrals). The cardmember pays for any services obtained.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.units: Up to $10,000 per item and $50,000 per calendar year
benefits.period_note: Coverage window is 120 days from purchase (90 days for New York residents); $50,000 cap per calendar year.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Theft, damage, or accidental loss of new purchases paid with the card and/or rewards. Secondary to other insurance. Start the claim within 90 days of loss; a police or incident report is needed within 48 hours.
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: Return Protection
benefits.units: Up to $500 per item and $1,000 per 12-month period per account
benefits.period_note: Within 90 days of purchase; $1,000 cap per 12 months per account.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Reimburses the purchase price when the retailer refuses a return within 90 days. Item must be returned in like-new condition at the cardmember's shipping expense. Excludes items bought outside the U.S., altered items, and many categories (formal attire, seasonal items, and others).
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.units: Up to $10,000 per item and $50,000 per account; adds one year to eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of three years or less
benefits.period_note: Combined coverage cannot exceed 3 years of manufacturer/store/service-contract warranty, and total coverage cannot exceed 4 years from purchase.
benefits.qualifying_merchants_or_rules: Item must carry a valid U.S. manufacturer warranty and be paid with the card and/or rewards. Excludes vehicles, software, medical equipment, and used items. Start the claim within 90 days of product failure.
benefits.verification_note: Read in the Guide to Benefits PDF on static.chasecdn.com and on creditcards.chase.com on 2026-10-28.
